problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(t+3),\,\sqrt{t}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the speed $|v|$ of the particle at time $t=1.$ Do not round the answer.

The speed at time $t=1$ is
{{field-1}}.

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating Velocity for Plane Motion Using Differentiation

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Speed of a Particle at a Given Time
examples.problem:
The position vector $\mathbf{r}$ of a particle $P$ relative to a fixed origin $O$ at time $t > 0$ is given by

$$
\mathbf{r} = \langle 6t^2+2, 2t^3\rangle.
$$

Calculate the speed of the particle at time $t=2.$
examples.worked_solution:
First, we calculate the velocity vector $\mathbf{v}.$ Differentiating the position vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\frac{\text{d}r}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(6{t}^{2}+2),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2{t}^{3})⟩ \\  & =⟨12t,6{t}^{2}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

To find the velocity when $t=2$, we substitute into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(2) & =⟨12(2),6(2)^{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨24,24⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

To find the speed at $t=2$ we calculate the magnitude of $\mathbf{v}(2),$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|v(2)| & =\sqrt{{24}^{2}+{24}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{2({24}^{2})} \\  & =24\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the speed when $t=2$ is $24\sqrt{2}\approx 33.94$ to two decimal places.

feedback.problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨t+4,\operatorname{ln}⁡(5t+1)⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=3.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The particle's velocity vector is given by the derivative of its position vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\frac{\text{d}r}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t+4),\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(5t+1))⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\frac{5}{5t+1}⟩\end{aligned}
$$

To find the velocity when $t=3,$ we substitute into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(3) & =⟨1,\frac{5}{5(3)+1}⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\frac{5}{16}⟩\end{aligned}
$$
